environment.description: Production deployment on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB is internet-facing with a default listener rule forwarding all traffic on port 443 to the target group. CORS is configured to allow all origins. The Rails API service uses shared session cookies (SameSite=None; Secure) with the main web application on the same parent domain. No CSRF token validation, no custom header requirement, no Origin checking.

config.alb: internet-facing, default HTTPS listener forwards all traffic
config.network: public subnets, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 443
